newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia and Philippines to boost economic ties.
newsitem.headline: Croatia and Philippines to boost economic ties.

text.p: The Philippines and Croatia are eager to strenghten their economic ties, particulary in the area of shipbuilding, visiting Philippine Economy Minister said on Monday.
"I hope we'll pave the way for stronger economic relations through trade and joint projects," Croatian state news agency HINA quoted Minister Cielito Habito as saying.
Habito, on a two-day trip to Croatia, on Monday met Croatian president Franjo Tudjman, Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa and his Croatian counterpart Davor Stern.
Habito said the two governments were looking into possible ways of more concrete cooperation in shipbuilding.
"I heard some encouraging statements from the (Croatian) government regarding possible transfer of the shipbuilding technology to my country," he told HINA.
Habito also said the Philippines were interested in Croatia's electronic and pharmaceutical industry.
Total trade between the two countries amounted to mere $1.5 million from January to November 1996, but is now on the rise, HINA said. -- Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
